isolated_lab_alignment.intentional_difference: No live obstacle observations are present in an immutable offline occupancy-map replay.

S000001.causality: The same out-of-map trajectory is returned with internal Smac smoothing disabled. An isolated allow_unknown=false replay also returned the same invalid trajectory; smoothing and that flag are therefore not a proven corrective mechanism.

S000003.causality: The raw unsmoothed path already intersects occupied cells. Deferring analytic expansion changes the returned path but still produces an invalid out-of-map path, so it does not establish a safe correction.

S000002.note: Under production-aligned footprint and inflation semantics this case is no longer Nav2-discretely valid; its final path first leaves the map between returned poses.

S000004.note: Nav2 discrete footprint validation passes, while continuous collision validation passes and the independent Ackermann check finds a 0.7530 m implied radius below the 1.09 m limit.

conclusion.planner_root_cause: The production-aligned isolated SmacPlannerHybrid lab returns paths that PlannerServer's official footprint validator rejects; S000001 exits the map and S000003 intersects occupied cells before any external controller is involved.
conclusion.planner_fix: NONE: a production configuration change is not justified until a safe alternative path is demonstrated for the same valid endpoint pairs.
